This Node.js native addon binds Nacos via napi-rs/nacos-sdk-rust. Rust: `src/*.rs`; `lib.rs` entry/`ClientOptions`, `config.rs` config client, `naming.rs` naming client, `plugin.rs` encryption/decryption filter. `index.d.ts` auto-generated. Rust `Option<T>` maps to TypeScript `T | undefined | null`; async methods return Promises; callbacks use `ThreadsafeFunction`; Nacos errors become JS `Error` with reason strings. raw_text:
This Node.js native addon binds Nacos via napi-rs/nacos-sdk-rust. Rust: `src/*.rs`; `lib.rs` entry/`ClientOptions`, `config.rs` config client, `naming.rs` naming client, `plugin.rs` encryption/decryption filter. `index.d.ts` auto-generated. Rust `Option<T>` maps to TypeScript `T | undefined | null`; async methods return Promises; callbacks use `ThreadsafeFunction`; Nacos errors become JS `Error` with reason strings. Clients maintain persistent gRPC connections and are stateful; create once and reuse. **removeListener/unSubscribe**: These are NOOPs - the underlying Rust SDK doesn't implement removal, but this is typically not problematic as listeners are long-lived

Package manager: Yarn 3.4.1. Build:
yarn build:debug

Target-specific builds: `yarn build --target <target-triple>`
Targets: macOS `x86_64-apple-darwin`, `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `universal-apple-darwin`; Linux `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/musl`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/musl`, `armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf`; Windows `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`, `i686-pc-windows-msvc`, `aarch64-pc-windows-msvc`; Android `aarch64-linux-android`, `armv7-linux-androideabi`.
Output: `nacos-sdk-rust-binding-node.<platform>.node`; definitions: `index.d.ts`.

Tests use AVA (3-minute timeout):
yarn test __test__/index.spec.mjs
Tests require the native addon first (`index.node` must exist).

Environment: `NACOS_CLIENT_LOGGER_LEVEL` (default `INFO`, `$HOME/logs/nacos/`); `NACOS_CLIENT_COMMON_THREAD_CORES` (default `1`); `NACOS_CLIENT_NAMING_PUSH_EMPTY_PROTECTION` (default `true`). See nacos-sdk-rust docs for more variables.

Auth supports HTTP token auth (username/password) or Alibaba Cloud RAM (access_key/access_secret). Build dependencies: `nacos-sdk-rust`, `napi`.

If build fails, ensure Rust toolchain is up to date: `rustup update stable && cargo update`
For cross-compilation issues, r
